notes.title: VERSION 2.0 & EVENING DREAMS - December 3rd
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce version 2.0 and the Evening Dreams Collection! Check out our teaser:
[previewyoutube=qAcuiBx8-Mo;full][/previewyoutube]
Along with this, the price will go up to $9.99 on December 3rd-- buy it before the price goes up and you'll get the 2.0 update and Evening Dreams at a [b]huge discount[/b]. 

This is a massive update, more than [i]doubling[/i] the number of screensavers. Other features include:[list]
[*] The Official Software Manual, written by Dave Kornfeld (formerly, The Onion)
[*] An original essay by After Dark co-creator Bill Stewart
[*] A spatialized desktop so real your desk will slide right down the grassy hill
[*] Improved movement options
[*] Mom's redecorating the office, come check it out!
[/list]

Black Friday is Sleep Mode Friday-- get your computer some rest and explore these Evening Dreams!
